notes: The app-scoped coordinator retains the exact Official origin and action across successful authentication for like, add comment and report comment on Android, Web/Wasm and iOS.
Like continuation records the requested state and avoids toggling an authenticated account away from a state that is already satisfied.
Comment continuation retains the submitted text and reply target; comment-report continuation retains both comment and parent post identifiers.
Official publication remains role-gated and is deliberately outside this continuation scope.
Cancellation, logout and rejected-session transitions keep the clearing behavior already certified by the Feed coordinator integration.
No backend fixture or remote mutation was required for this focal preflight. GitHub final jobs retain responsibility for clean-runner integrated certification.
Communities and actions outside the three listed Official interactions remain separate inventory scope.
